scope: Independent static review of delivery_audit's separately prepared thirteen-file CRLF-compatible history input packet. Runtime source and actual disposable qualification are accepted by the separate frontend review; this review accepts inert preparation only.

checks.name: Complete payload and author records
checks.evidence: Read the complete README, checklist, author record, request schema and both receipt templates. Independently hashed all thirteen final files; all twelve payload entries match both final author inspections.

checks.name: Exact narrow eight-request changes
checks.evidence: For every phase, reversing only helper 1015fa58 to ff1597b3 and supervisor c0c289a9 to 1dd2e70b reproduces the complete c6d92ee original request bytes. All phase names, roots, plan/map/native/Node/Git/Job pins, actual-result fields and root attestations are unchanged.

checks.name: Inert requests and future receipts
checks.evidence: Every supervisor_output, future accepted/prior path and hash, cleanup revision and reason is null; all five attestations are false. The exact supervisor checks Safe-Path(supervisor_output) before creating its output directory. Both null future receipt schemas are byte-identical to the original packet. These prepared requests do not claim phase execution.

checks.name: Unchanged original consumer schema
checks.evidence: Independently compared every original checklist root/input/phase/baseline/guard section. The post-handoff baseline still requires current native HEAD equal observed fork main, exact original checkpoint tree, all 53 immutable objects, true verified remote objects, and a raw-index backup strictly under coordination, reopened by every phase.

checks.name: Prerequisite and direct-prior timing
checks.evidence: Traced the exact history driver's pin, prior and kept reads. Every pinned prerequisite for preserve is staged under coordination while retention stays absent; actual direct priors use the fixed phase result paths. Original Git baseline is captured after actual handoff adoption. Initial checkpoint publication occurs after restore-original plus disposable restore and before close; final publication follows final-restore.

checks.name: Current compatible source and runtime pins
checks.evidence: Rehashed all eight referenced compatibility components from immutable de71118c. Both existing lowercase-passed runtime consumer receipts match their exact source bytes, final native 0431 / source 2d801, and coordinate-only future destinations.

checks.name: Raw and canonical retention contract
checks.evidence: The four raw CRLF files total 17,088,721 bytes; exact canonical Git counterparts total 17,063,501 bytes. Distinct retention paths, canonical original 954-issue restore before the 1,009-issue source restore, raw index/config/ignore preservation and all 53 immutable Git entries agree with the accepted helper. Config bytes are compared within and across phases without changing core.autocrlf.

checks.name: Initial-only pointer normalization
checks.evidence: The first publication permits only previous.json equal to the exact preserved 920-byte old current raw SHA ccb1abde and canonical Git blob fb204445. Both retention sets and unchanged old root are required. Every other changed file remains a raw Git-object equality check; final publication uses the strict verifier. Both actual phase request helper hashes must match 1015fa58 in each publisher phase pair.

checks.name: Close and final-phase guards
checks.evidence: The actual cleanup pre-close revision is read live, the reason is trimmed and 80–4096 characters, and close's incremented revision is distinguished from the reused request revision. The first publication receipt remains the input for final phases, avoiding a future-result cycle. Frozen coordination DB/checkpoint, baseline raw-index copy and all pinned outputs survive through final-restore.

checks.name: Resource, no-replay and authority instructions
checks.evidence: Prepared runbook retains root-only execution/attestation, fresh one-shot phase and immediate coordination supervisor directories, process-only ExecutionPolicy Bypass, actual PS5.1 parse/staged identities, 3 GiB admission, 1 GiB live floor, 512 MiB aggregate, 128 MiB Node, 180 seconds and 12-second cleanup. Occupied paths or uncertain outcomes require actual-state reconciliation.

checks.evidence: The one concrete finding was the former unpublished source-directory locator. Final README now points to the exact de71118c/20261127/checkpoint-crlf-handoff permalink. Requests, receipt schemas and checklist remain unchanged; the author record preserves the correction.
